Method change vs v1. The v1 page matched AI to manual snags with a text mapping that credited one AI prediction against many manual rows (183 "common" snags from 34 AI predictions, "73% recall"). v2 retires that mapping: a blind judge rules per manual snag whether a contractor working the pack would fix it. Re-judged under this stricter standard, the original AI addressed 22% and visited 50%; the verified pipeline behind this page addressed 70% and visited 94% of in-scope snags (64% / 95% on rooms never used for tuning; control on those rooms: 30% / 60%).
